### Psalm 1: When Delight Overcomes Distraction
Author: Brian Tabb
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/psalm-1-when-delight-overcomes-distraction
Passage: Psalm 1:1-2
Points:
- Psalm 1 contrasts two exclusive lifestyles: following worldly values or living by God's Word.
- While the ungodly pursue fleeting independence, the righteous flourish like well-nourished trees.
- True delight is an affection of the heart, while meditation is an intentional discipline of the mind.
- Diligent biblical meditation sustains joy and overcomes constant modern distractions.
- Believers can cultivate meditation through consistent habits like reading aloud, taking notes, and memorizing Scripture.

### Delighting in the Law of the Lord
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-devotion-august-3-2026.html
Passage: Psalm 1:1-3
Points:
- Godliness requires actively pursuing what is good, not simply avoiding bad habits.
- The blessed person moves forward by finding ongoing delight and direction in God's Word.
- Scripture should not be read sporadically or out of mere obligation.
- Approaching the Bible like an expectant treasure hunt uncovers practical guidance and transforms life.
